statement:
I am an artist based in London. My textile design background shapes my approach to creating innovative, spontaneous, and critical paintings. I incorporate fashion and textile methods of sampling and appropriation through distinct designs, textures, and colour combinations. I also draw on colour field painting and artists who emphasise process as a source of meaning. My work explores how legacies, contexts, and meanings in painting can shift, and how painterly vocabularies can be reclaimed and challenged.

I aim for my paintings to be joyful, euphoric, inquisitive, and conscious of their process and history. My approach is experimental and research-driven, often starting with digital studies that explore colour and material combinations.

I work directly into an absorbent wet ground, letting marks spread, bind, and move together to create both rhythm and controlled spontaneity. A recurring motif honeycomb, bubble wrap, or dot emerges at various levels in each painting, adapting its arrangement to suit each work.
